title: Where does the phrase arrive?
exercise: An original four-bar open-string tune in 2/4, one quarter note on each beat: D A | A D | D D | A D. Choose one note as a destination and shape the phrase toward it; try a different destination on a second pass. You can point to or sing the notes before trying them on violin. Keep your own impressions private if you wish. No recording or listener is required.
